summary: Welcome to GOVER by Team Ophiolite! For this NASA Space Apps Challenge, we built a retro-inspired cosmic adventure powered by real space history. The journey begins on Earth when a mysterious VHS tape is discovered in the orchard. Taking the tape back home, the player inserts it into the VCR. This triggers an engaging, interactive educational video about the spacecraft—giving players a thrilling preview before the adventure truly begins. Once the video concludes, the interactive game sets into motion: a futuristic cat guide named GOVER appears. Together, they embark on an urgent mission: to travel across the solar system, uncover the forgotten stories of silent spacecraft left behind on distant worlds, and repair them to restore their connection with Earth. Stepping into the space adventure, players embark on a three-stage pixel-art quest. Across their journey—from Earth, to aboard the spacecraft before an emergency lunar landing, and finally to Mars—players uncover three distinct VHS tapes that reveal the full story. By navigating hazardous labs, surviving lunar terrain, battling alien threats, and answering space-history questions based on the educational videos they watched, players unlock the engineering marvels and hidden legacies of NASA's historic missions—turning complex space data into an unforgettable, hands-on adventure.
details:
Ophiolite's Project Solution GOVER is an interactive, story-driven educational game designed to teach students and space enthusiasts about abandoned and historic spacecraft by turning authentic NASA mission data into an engaging retro video game. Players team up with GOVER to travel from Earth to the Moon and Mars—collecting gear, repairing silent spacecraft, restoring their signals, and answering space-science questions that make space exploration both accessible and thrilling. How Does Our Solution Work? The game unfolds across a structured, three-level narrative rhythm that blends platformer action with three educational VHS tapes discovered along the journey Level 1 – The Space Lab: The player discovers the first mysterious VHS tape in the grass of the orchard and plays it on the VCR at home. Watching the opening chapter of NASA's Mars InSight mission—detailing its inception, early challenges, and design—sets the mission in motion. Players then navigate a hazard-filled laboratory to collect essential survival equipment (spacesuit, oxygen tank, and rocket parts) while answering space-history questions based on the video. Level 2 – Emergency on the Moon: While traveling through space, the player finds a second VHS tape on the pilot's seat inside the spacecraft and plays it on the onboard VCR, uncovering the next chapter of the mission before a sudden spacecraft failure forces an emergency lunar landing. Players explore lunar terrain, dodge alien hazards, gather repair tools, and answer deeper scientific questions to fix their ship and continue. Level 3 – The Red Planet & Mission Finale: Arriving on Mars, the player discovers the third and final VHS tape on the Martian surface, revealing the concluding chapters of the InSight story (addressing Martian dust, the "Mole" heat probe challenges, and its emotional final transmission). To reach the abandoned lander, players collect weapons and shields, defeat the Final Boss, and answer advanced mission-milestone questions to repair the spacecraft and successfully restore communication with Earth.
